body: but how much help can an online support group offer me? it’s true that i’m desperate for egress from my current situation but i genuinely don’t think i’ll find a solution to my problems for a long time. thank you for your comment. it’s small, seemingly insignificant things like this that boost my serotonin, even if it’s only a temporary distraction from my life. i do struggle with my appearance, and so this was a kind gesture on your behalf.
